summary.overview: In the exploratory discussion between Robbie Crittall and Andy Day, key topics included Robbie's management of a brand experience agency serving Fortune 250 technology companies, the challenges of succession planning, and the need for synchronization among his management team. As Robbie considers his exit strategy and explores the option of finding a merger partner, Andy presented potential buyers and outlined possible deal structures, including cash and equity rollover, emphasizing the value of mergers tailored to technology and FMCG sectors. Robbie expressed a desire to connect with similar agencies and complete the current fiscal year before engaging in further discussions. Action items included reviewing fiscal year-end results and following up on merger services and potential introduction to acquisition partners.
summary.short_summary: Robbie Crittall, who manages a brand experience agency catering to Fortune 250 technology companies, engaged in an exploratory discussion with Andy Day, founder/CEO of Capital A, an M&A advisory. The meeting focused on the challenges Robbie faces regarding succession planning, particularly with his management team lacking synchronization. Robbie is considering an exit strategy and potential merger partners, with Andy suggesting deal structures that include cash and equity rollover. The agency's financials reflect a downturn, projecting £13M in sales and £300-350K in EBITDA for the current fiscal year. As he seeks to finalize the fiscal year ending June 30 before further discussions, Robbie expressed interest in connecting with similar agencies and exploring strategic partnerships in technology and FMCG sectors.
